title: Route immutable dependency pin updates through targeted strict quality
rawUserRequest: Continue: correct the root cause that makes a narrowly scoped immutable dependency pin update invoke unnecessary full-repository quality, then resume dependency PR reconciliation and the release-cleanliness audit.

declaredIntent.summary: Make narrowly proven immutable dependency pin updates converge through targeted strict local quality while preserving strict governance and hosted proof.

outOfScope: Process-tree cancellation, hard timeouts, and scratch worktree cleanup; handled by the follow-up cancellation/timeout Work Item.
Changing the dependency pin or any .github/workflows/** file; the successor dependency Work Item owns that change.
Release/signing workflow routing, mutable tags, action identity changes, or any non-pin workflow behavior change.
Hosted CI policy or hosted verification requirements.
requirements-dev.in, lockfiles, installer catalog redesign, and new capability implementations.

sources.reason: Current strict/full and strict-targeted routing policy.
Current governance profile classifier and dispatch receipt.
Finish-time quality path selection and Make invocation.
Existing governance receipt and profile behavior tests.
Declared path risk levels; strict workflow risk must remain strict.
Adopter-installed runtime surface for the existing routing scripts.

riskAssessment.reason: The change must reduce unnecessary local work without weakening strict classification or hosted proof.

reasons: The change modifies governance routing and verification dispatch.

executionDecision.reason: The scope, evidence sources, and fail-closed scenarios are deterministic and bounded.

preReviewWarnings: Verify that strict risk classification remains strict while only the local test graph is narrowed for an evidence-bound immutable pin diff.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: An exact one-line immutable action SHA replacement in one non-release/non-signing workflow retains governanceProfile strict and routes local quality to strict-targeted with only quality-fast.
A mutable tag, action identity change, extra workflow line, multiple pin change, release/signing workflow, or missing base/current evidence remains quality-full.

determine_governance_profile.py and ai_finish.py use the same evidence-bound classification and do not let generated status, outcome, task-report, or start projections escalate an otherwise eligible pin-only change.

The routing receipt records the changed paths, eligibility facts, rejection reason when applicable, dispatch target, and required groups without recording file contents or relying on a self-declared Contract flag.
The existing installer surface still contains the routing scripts and adopter parity verification remains green.
Focused routing tests, required AI checks, and project quality checks pass; hosted PR checks remain required for the successor dependency update.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: One workflow line changes only from one 40-hex action SHA to another and routes strict-targeted with quality-fast only.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add and run a focused policy test with base/current workflow contents and assert the routing receipt.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The workflow also changes a second line or action behavior and remains quality-full.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused negative cases for an extra workflow line and assert full routing.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A tag, branch, action identity, or non-SHA reference changes and remains quality-full.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused negative cases for mutable refs and action identity changes and assert full routing.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An otherwise SHA-only change occurs in a release or signing workflow and remains quality-full.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a release/signing workflow case and assert it remains full routing.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Generated lifecycle projections change alongside an eligible workflow line without escalating risk routing.
scenarioCoverage.expected: generated paths do not escalate an eligible workflow pin change
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add governance and finish-path tests with generated projections present and assert consistent targeted routing.

guidelines: Keep the governance profile strict; narrow only the evidence-proven local verification graph.
Fail closed when the base/current diff cannot prove the exact immutable SHA-only shape.
Keep routing logic centralized so determine_governance_profile.py and ai_finish.py cannot disagree.
Preserve the existing installer catalog and installed runtime parity surface.

intent.problem: A one-line immutable dependency action pin update is currently escalated to quality-full because strict workflow paths and generated governance projections are mixed into routing inputs. This invokes a 2718-entry local quality graph and full-repository checks for a narrowly bounded change, making Work Item completion non-convergent.
constraints: Release and signing workflows plus non-pin workflow changes retain full quality.
Eligibility is proven from repository base and current file contents.
Hosted CI remains final proof and is not bypassed.
Adopter projects receive the behavior through the existing installed scripts.
intent.rationale: Separate risk level from local verification scope: strict risk remains visible, while an exact immutable-pin evidence receipt permits only the smallest safe local strict group.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user instructed continuation and requires the governance routing root cause to be corrected through a governed Work Item.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
